title: China-to-Sweden Solar PV Inverter Compliance Gap Matrix
provenance: AI-compiled, multi-model cross-checked, not human-verified. Informational only; confirm with the official regulator and a qualified professional. Not legal/certification/customs/market-access advice.

rows.requirement: EMC — IEC 62920 and SS-EN 61000 Evidence for Sweden PV Inverters
rows.target_requirement: Sweden PV inverter EMC expectations should be prepared on an EU/IEC basis because SIS is the national standards body adopting European standards as SS-EN, and project specifications for grid-connected PV commonly reference IEC-family inverter evidence under the EMC Directive 2014/30/EU. The practical EMC package should include IEC 62920 for PV power conversion equipment and applicable SS-EN 61000-series evidence for emissions, immunity, harmonics, surge, voltage dips, and power quality. For Svenska kraftnät / DSO grid-connected projects (overseen by Ei), harmonic and conducted-emission evidence should be tied to the actual inverter model, rating, and configuration. Sweden uses a 230/400 V, 50 Hz grid; while the frequency matches China, the nominal voltage differs from China's 220/380 V, so EMC and harmonic results obtained only under China conditions should be reviewed for applicability before submission.
target_standards: IEC 62920 — Photovoltaic power generating systems — EMC requirements and test methods for power conversion equipment
SS-EN 61000 series — Electromagnetic compatibility test, immunity, harmonic, surge, voltage-dip, and power-quality standards (SIS adoption) as applicable to the inverter configuration
EMC Directive 2014/30/EU and SIS standards adoption requirements where applicable
Svenska kraftnät / DSO grid-connection review requirements for power quality and harmonic performance (overseen by Ei)
rows.china_equivalent: Chinese PV inverter EMC evidence commonly relies on GB/T 37408-2021 and related domestic EMC test reports from CNAS-accredited laboratories. These reports can be useful engineering background but are not automatically equivalent to IEC 62920 or the SS-EN 61000-series evidence requested by a Sweden project owner, SIS SS-EN conformity route, Ei oversight, or Svenska kraftnät / DSO grid-connection process. China test conditions are normally aligned with the China 220/380 V, 50 Hz baseline, while Sweden uses 230/400 V at the same frequency.
china_standards: GB/T 37408-2021 — 光伏并网逆变器技术要求 (Technical Requirements for Photovoltaic Grid-Connected Inverters)
CNAS-accredited domestic EMC test reports under China standard scopes
rows.gap: Gap: China-only EMC certificates under GB/T 37408 do not automatically satisfy Sweden EU/IEC-based project expectations under the EMC Directive. Exporters should obtain IEC 62920 and applicable SS-EN 61000-series reports for the specific model or family, confirm whether harmonics and conducted-emission results remain valid at 230/400 V, and provide surge, earthing, shielding, and enclosure documentation suitable for cold-climate Nordic installations. Where Svenska kraftnät, the DSO, or the project owner specifies harmonic limits or power-quality measurements, test reports should be mapped clause-by-clause to that requirement, and Swedish-language documentation may be expected.

mandatory_status.target: Mandatory under the EMC Directive 2014/30/EU for CE marking; project-specific and effectively mandatory where Svenska kraftnät, the DSO (overseen by Ei), or project-owner documentation calls for IEC EMC and power-quality evidence
mandatory_status.cn: GB/T 37408 EMC evidence is a China domestic voluntary or certification-programme baseline and is not a Sweden EU/IEC evidence substitute

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Treat Sweden PV inverter EMC as an EU/IEC evidence package under the EMC Directive, not a China GB/T certificate transfer. Prepare IEC 62920 and applicable SS-EN 61000-series reports for the exact inverter model, review harmonic and EMC applicability at Sweden's 230/400 V 50 Hz grid voltage, document cold-climate suitability, and confirm any Svenska kraftnät, Ei, DSO, or project-owner EMC requirements before shipment.

rows.requirement: Sweden Svenska kraftnät / Ei Grid-Connection Review — IEC 62116, IEC 61727, SS-EN 50549, and 230/400 V 50 Hz Settings
rows.target_requirement: Grid-connected solar PV inverters in Sweden should be treated as project-level grid-connection equipment subject to the relevant DSO connection review and the national grid code set by Svenska kraftnät (the transmission system operator), with sector oversight by the Energy Markets Inspectorate (Ei). The practical evidence package normally includes SS-EN 50549-1/-2 grid-code compliance, IEC 62116 anti-islanding and IEC 61727 utility-interface compliance, with firmware protection thresholds, reconnection delay, voltage windows, and frequency windows validated for Sweden's 230/400 V, 50 Hz low-voltage grid. Sweden uses the same 50 Hz frequency as China, but the nominal voltage differs: Sweden is 230 V single-phase and 400 V three-phase, while China is 220/380 V under GB/T 156. Sweden is a cold-climate Nordic market, so commissioning files should also document low-temperature operation, thermal derating, and snow/ice assumptions for the installed site.
target_standards: SS-EN 50549-1 / SS-EN 50549-2 — requirements for generating plants connected to distribution networks (SIS adoption; Swedish grid-code reference)
IEC 62116 — Utility-interconnected photovoltaic inverters — Test procedure of islanding prevention measures

Svenska kraftnät grid-code requirements and DSO project grid-connection / commissioning requirements
Energy Markets Inspectorate (Ei) electricity-sector oversight requirements where applicable
Sweden low-voltage grid context — 230 V single-phase / 400 V three-phase, 50 Hz
rows.china_equivalent: Chinese PV inverter grid-connection evidence commonly includes GB/T 19964-2024 for PV power station connection, NB/T 32004 for grid-connected inverter technical specifications, GB/T 37408 for PV grid-connected inverter requirements, and domestic anti-islanding test results. These documents are built around China grid conditions and domestic acceptance procedures. China's low-voltage baseline is 220/380 V at 50 Hz, not Sweden's 230/400 V at 50 Hz. Chinese grid certificates and factory firmware settings do not automatically transfer to Svenska kraftnät / DSO acceptance or Ei oversight in Sweden.

NB/T 32004-2018 — 光伏并网逆变器技术规范 (Technical Specification for Photovoltaic Grid-Connected Inverters)

rows.gap: Gap: China GB/T and NB/T grid-connection evidence is not a substitute for Sweden Svenska kraftnät / DSO project acceptance. Exporters should prepare SS-EN 50549-1/-2 grid-code evidence, IEC 62116 anti-islanding evidence, IEC 61727 utility-interface evidence, a Sweden-specific settings file, and commissioning records for 230/400 V at 50 Hz. Do not describe Sweden voltage as matching China: only the 50 Hz frequency matches, while nominal voltage differs from China's 220/380 V. For Nordic cold-climate sites, include low-temperature operation, snow/ice loading, thermal derating, earthing, surge protection, and weak-grid ride-through assumptions in the project file, with Swedish-language documentation where expected.

mandatory_status.target: Mandatory in practice for grid-connected projects through DSO technical review and the Svenska kraftnät grid code (overseen by Ei); SS-EN 50549 is the applicable grid-code standard adopted by SIS
mandatory_status.cn: Chinese grid-connection evidence satisfies China domestic grid acceptance only and is not a Svenska kraftnät / DSO Sweden approval substitute

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Chinese GB/T grid-connection documents do not automatically satisfy Sweden Svenska kraftnät / DSO grid-connection review. Prepare SS-EN 50549-1/-2, IEC 62116 and IEC 61727 evidence, re-parameterise inverter firmware for Sweden's 230/400 V at 50 Hz grid, and document cold-climate low-temperature operation and thermal derating for Nordic installation. Verify current Svenska kraftnät, DSO, and Ei project requirements directly before shipment or commissioning.

rows.requirement: IEC 62109-1 / IEC 62109-2 Safety Evidence and Cold-Climate Derating for Sweden PV Inverters
rows.target_requirement: For Sweden solar PV projects, inverter safety documentation should be prepared around IEC 62109-1 and IEC 62109-2 type-test evidence (adopted by SIS as SS-EN IEC 62109) for the exact inverter model or family, supporting CE marking under the Low Voltage Directive 2014/35/EU. SIS is the national standards body, Ei oversees the energy sector, Svenska kraftnät sets the grid code, and Elsäkerhetsverket supervises electrical safety, so project submissions should include accredited IEC safety reports, installation manuals, ratings, nameplate data, protection-device coordination, earthing instructions, and environmental limits. Sweden is a cold-climate Nordic market, so safety files should also address low-temperature operation (often down to -40 °C), enclosure ingress protection, snow/ice loading, terminal temperature rise, ventilation, and derating for cold-climate exposure.
target_standards: IEC 62109-1 / SS-EN IEC 62109-1 — Safety of power converters for use in photovoltaic power systems — Part 1: General requirements
IEC 62109-2 / SS-EN IEC 62109-2 — Safety of power converters for use in photovoltaic power systems — Part 2: Particular requirements for inverters
LVD 2014/35/EU and SIS standards adoption and conformity expectations where applicable

Project environmental requirements for cold-climate low-temperature operation, snow/ice loading, ingress protection, and thermal derating
rows.china_equivalent: China safety documentation for PV grid-connected inverters commonly uses GB/T 37408-2021, NB/T 32004, domestic CQC or CGC voluntary certification, and CNAS-accredited laboratory reports. These documents are useful for supplier qualification but are not automatically accepted as IEC 62109-1/-2 / SS-EN IEC 62109 evidence for Sweden projects. Chinese safety reports may also be based on China-rated configurations, labels, manuals, surge protection, and 220/380 V assumptions, while Sweden project files must reflect 230/400 V, 50 Hz installation conditions and cold-climate environmental exposure.
china_standards: GB/T 37408-2021 — 光伏并网逆变器技术要求 (Technical Requirements for Photovoltaic Grid-Connected Inverters)
NB/T 32004-2018 — 光伏并网逆变器技术规范 (Technical Specification for Photovoltaic Grid-Connected Inverters)
CQC / CGC voluntary certification programmes for China domestic PV inverter safety and performance
rows.gap: Gap: A China-only GB/T 37408 or NB/T 32004 safety file does not automatically satisfy Sweden IEC/SS-EN safety expectations or LVD CE-marking requirements. Exporters should provide IEC 62109-1/-2 (SS-EN IEC 62109) type-test reports for the supplied model or model family, confirm that labels and manuals match the Sweden configuration (with Swedish-language documentation where expected), document protection coordination and earthing, and add environmental evidence for cold-climate low-temperature operation, ingress protection, snow/ice loading, ventilation, and thermal derating. Any changes to enclosure, terminals, firmware settings, surge protection, or nameplate ratings for Sweden can require updated safety documentation.

mandatory_status.target: Mandatory — CE marking under LVD 2014/35/EU is required for Swedish (EU) market access; SS-EN IEC 62109 evidence supports presumption of conformity. Effectively mandatory where Ei, Svenska kraftnät, the DSO, EPC, lender, insurer, or project-owner documentation requires IEC 62109 safety evidence for grid-connected PV inverters
mandatory_status.cn: China GB/T, NB/T, CQC, or CGC safety evidence applies to China domestic or voluntary certification contexts and is not automatically transferable to Sweden

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Do not rely on China GB/T or NB/T inverter safety files alone for Sweden PV projects. Prepare IEC 62109-1/-2 (SS-EN IEC 62109) type-test evidence for the exact model to support LVD CE marking, align labels and manuals to Sweden's 230/400 V 50 Hz configuration (with Swedish-language documentation where expected), and document cold-climate low-temperature operation, snow/ice loading, ingress-protection, and thermal-derating controls. Confirm current SIS, Ei, Svenska kraftnät, Elsäkerhetsverket, and project-owner safety requirements before shipment.
